citation.authors: Liu JB, Li M, Yang S, et al

cited_by.title: Vitiligo, spread, starting age and treatment options

record.finding: Mean age of onset was 18.88 years and more than 60% were affected before 20. Segmental vitiligo began earlier (15.55 years). After 3 to 5 years, 99% of active vitiligo had worsened or shifted from one clinical type to another.
record.note: Chinese clinic population, retrospective, and the 99% applies to patients whose vitiligo was classed as active, not to everyone with vitiligo.
